question: Pooja, Neha, and Manoj can do a piece of work in 16, 22, and 20 days respectively. On which day will the work get finished if Pooja is assisted by both Neha and Manoj on every second day?
solution:
**Data:**

Work rates of Pooja (Wp), Neha (Wn), and Manoj (Wm) = 1/16, 1/22, 1/20 work/day respectively

**Concept:**

On the first day, only Pooja works. On the second day, all three work together.

This pattern repeats.

The total work done on each two-day cycle is the sum of the work done by each person.

**Solution:**

Calculate the LCM of 16, 22, and 20 to represent the total work.

⇒ LCM of 16, 22, and 20 = 880 units

Calculate the one-day work for Pooja, Neha, and Manoj respectively.

⇒ Pooja's one day work = 880/16 = 55 units

⇒ Neha's one day work = 880/22 = 40 units

&a
